note: The main menu as the exe boots (re/screens/mainscr.md §13): the rings fly in (Tav 10 -> 1 over 180 UI ticks) and the scene fades in (GlobalTransparency +0.003 a tick); the pointer rests on the load ring (ring 2) and then on the exit ring (ring 1); a press on the single-player ring (ring 4) flies the rings out and back as the single-player set; the pointer on its back ring. Ring centres move with MainScrMozgato (M = t/10): the points are where the rings are at those ticks.
